The acceptance prose reads as though the report and db spans can be NESTED BENEATH the scenario.run root. They cannot, and the acceptance text is deliberately left unedited as the record of what was ASKED. WHAT IS ACHIEVABLE: scenario.run is per-scenario at the composition root (conductor-run::execute_scenario, lib.rs:253), parenting timeline.execute, emit.batch and verify.readback* -- one instrumentation site serving all three production paths. WHAT IS NOT: report.generate and db.insert_run nested beneath that root. The code-graph shows persist() is a SIBLING of execute_scenario, called by execute_scenario's own callers at all three production sites -- conductor-cli commands/run/run() (run.rs:23 execute, :25 persist), conductor-cli commands/suite/suite() (suite.rs:30 execute, :36 persist), and conductor-run drive_run() (lib.rs:481 execute, :485 persist, plus a second persist at :478 on the abort path). Under suite and drive_run a SINGLE persist serves N scenarios whose spans have already closed, so no one scenario.run can contain db.insert_run. The two terminal spans are therefore emitted at the persist boundary and correlated by run_id, which the subscriber layer already stamps flat on every line (obs.rs:265-268).
